summary: Teck Resources and Anglo American announced the composition of Anglo Teck's future leadership team ahead of their merger, first announced September 9, 2025. The combined company will be called Anglo Teck plc, with Duncan Wanblad as CEO, Jonathan Price as Deputy CEO, and John Heasley as CFO. Merger completion is conditional on final regulatory approval, expected between September 2026 and March 2027. Board composition will be confirmed prior to completion. This filing updates merger management structure, not a new event. What to watch: regulatory approval timeline and any conditions.
